     1  /-

     6  module

    11  public import Mathlib.Tactic.PPWithUniv
    12  
    13  /-!
    14  # Order homomorphisms
    15  
    16  This file defines order homomorphisms, which are bundled monotone functions. A preorder
    17  homomorphism `f : α →o β` is a function `α → β` along with a proof that `∀ x y, x ≤ y → f x ≤ f y`.
    18  
    19  ## Main definitions
    20  
    21  In this file we define the following bundled monotone maps:
    22  * `OrderHom α β` a.k.a. `α →o β`: Preorder homomorphism.
    23    An `OrderHom α β` is a function `f : α → β` such that `a₁ ≤ a₂ → f a₁ ≤ f a₂`
    24  * `OrderEmbedding α β` a.k.a. `α ↪o β`: Relation embedding.
    25    An `OrderEmbedding α β` is an embedding `f : α ↪ β` such that `a ≤ b ↔ f a ≤ f b`.
    26    Defined as an abbreviation of `@RelEmbedding α β (≤) (≤)`.
    27  * `OrderIso`: Relation isomorphism.
    28    An `OrderIso α β` is an equivalence `f : α ≃ β` such that `a ≤ b ↔ f a ≤ f b`.
    29    Defined as an abbreviation of `@RelIso α β (≤) (≤)`.
    30  
    31  We also define many `OrderHom`s. In some cases we define two versions, one with `ₘ` suffix and
    32  one without it (e.g., `OrderHom.compₘ` and `OrderHom.comp`). This means that the former
    33  function is a "more bundled" version of the latter. We can't just drop the "less bundled" version
    34  because the more bundled version usually does not work with dot notation.
    35  
    36  * `OrderHom.id`: identity map as `α →o α`;
    37  * `OrderHom.curry`: an order isomorphism between `α × β →o γ` and `α →o β →o γ`;
    38  * `OrderHom.comp`: composition of two bundled monotone maps;
    39  * `OrderHom.compₘ`: composition of bundled monotone maps as a bundled monotone map;
    40  * `OrderHom.const`: constant function as a bundled monotone map;
    41  * `OrderHom.prod`: combine `α →o β` and `α →o γ` into `α →o β × γ`;
    42  * `OrderHom.prodₘ`: a more bundled version of `OrderHom.prod`;
    43  * `OrderHom.prodIso`: order isomorphism between `α →o β × γ` and `(α →o β) × (α →o γ)`;
    44  * `OrderHom.diag`: diagonal embedding of `α` into `α × α` as a bundled monotone map;
    45  * `OrderHom.onDiag`: restrict a monotone map `α →o α →o β` to the diagonal;
    46  * `OrderHom.fst`: projection `Prod.fst : α × β → α` as a bundled monotone map;
    47  * `OrderHom.snd`: projection `Prod.snd : α × β → β` as a bundled monotone map;
    48  * `OrderHom.prodMap`: `Prod.map f g` as a bundled monotone map;
    49  * `Pi.evalOrderHom`: evaluation of a function at a point `Function.eval i` as a bundled
    50    monotone map;
"}]
